lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 8 distinct vertical line segments visible. Spacing is irregular, with wider gaps on the anterior torso and increased density/narrowing between lines on the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 4th vertical line from the anterior, splitting approximately 70% of the way up the torso toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 7th and 8th lines on the posterior flank are truncated, appearing as dashed or abbreviated segments that fail to reach the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper hind limb and posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the upper posterior flank align horizontally, creating a short semi-connected geometric line across the haunch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with an initial upward and outward vector from the skull, transitioning into a convergent inward curve at the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 2.2 times the combined pixel width of the two horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the terminal 15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white V-shaped chevron between the medial eye margins and a distinct white transverse band on the lower neck.
